rawFindings.title: Inconsistent key handling in v1 Object decoding
rawFindings.explanation: When reading keys in readObject, the code was enhanced to check typeof key before filtering keys that match /^this\$\d+$/, allowing keys of type string or number only to be set on the result object. This change avoids non-string/number keys to be added to the result object.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep the added type check for key in readObject to restrict keys to string or number, preventing invalid keys.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Inputs with keys of non-string/number type in serialized data would not be included in the decoded object, preventing invalid properties from appearing.

rawFindings.title: Inconsistent key handling in v2 map decoding (_readMap)
rawFindings.explanation: In the _readMap method, after reading key-value pairs, setting map[k] = v is now guarded by a check ensuring k's type is string or number. This prevents non-string/number keys to be added to the map object, improving type safety.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep the added typeof check before adding keys to internal map object to ensure only string or number keys are included.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Deserialization of maps with non-string/number keys will omit such keys from the resulting map object, avoiding unintended properties.

rawFindings.title: Test fix for map decoding of null key
rawFindings.explanation: The test expected the decoded map with a null key to be { null: 'null' }, but the object was changed to exclude such keys resulting in an empty object {}. Test expectations updated accordingly.
rawFindings.suggestion: Update test expectations to match new decoding behavior that excludes invalid or unsupported keys like null.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Test will fail if expecting null keys in decoded objects which are now omitted.

rawFindings.title: Test fix for decoded plain object with non-string keys
rawFindings.explanation: The test expected a plain object to have a property '[object Object]': 166239, but due to modifications avoiding non-string keys, resulting object is now {}. Test expectations updated to expect empty object.
rawFindings.suggestion: Update test to expect empty object when map keys are non-string and thus omitted in decoding.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Test fails if expecting keys from serialized data that are not strings, which are now omitted.
